en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view of a small forested settlement centered on a railway station area and square. In the foreground is a dirt parking area with a few 1950s-era cars, a small white shed, and a simple gas station with two pumps. Behind this are wooden houses with steep tiled roofs and a small commercial building, all surrounded by dense coniferous forest. Railway tracks run along the bottom edge. Printed caption text at the lower left reads "UTTRAN. Stationsplan" and a small circular logo with the word "Copyright" and number "301215" appears at the lower right.
